q: explain on the app
answer:
The WorldCup 2026 Social Predictions app allows you to predict scores, climb leaderboards, and engage with friends in a fun way during the tournament. You can make predictions for each game, choose a Champion and Top Scorer for each group, and participate in a knockout bracket game. 

The app features a dashboard for tracking your predictions, group standings, and trivia questions. Points are awarded based on the accuracy of your predictions, and there's a nightly AI roast for some light-hearted fun.
